basics.name: Laura Garrison
basics.label: Visualization Researcher
basics.summary: My research focuses on designing visual tools and methods to support exploration and communication about phenomena in our world, and investigates the impacts of visual data design strategies on audience engagement through alternative theories and epistemologies.

volunteer.organization: Vesalius Trust for Visual Communication in the Health Sciences
volunteer.summary: The Vesalius Trust, founded in 1988, fosters the study, research and practice in visual communication of health information at all levels. From childhood through the practice of medicine and cutting-edge research, learning from quality imagery is increasingly important in today’s high energy digital world. Join us to help ensure the future of this important mission.
